text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Zimbabwe's annual gross domestic product (GDP) averaged less than one percent during the first five years of market reforms which ended last year, while total debt soared to over Z$43 billion, the United Nations has said.
- World attention will be focused on southern Africa in October as business and finance leaders meet in Zimbabwe to assess the investment climate in one of Africa's fastest growing regions.
- The final round of talks between Zimbabwe and South Africa aimed at forging a new agricultural trade pact will be held next month, co-chairman of Zimbabwe's negotiating team David Hasluck said.
